releases.name: Release v0.2.0
releases.body:
## What's Changed
* chore(deps-dev): update uv-build requirement from =0.12.17 to >=0.12.19,<0.13.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/agniveshtm/flux/pull/5
* Phase 1.1: add ICO, AVIF, GIF; fix output mapping and progress polling by @agniveshtm in https://github.com/agniveshtm/flux/pull/6

## New Contributors
* @dependabot[bot] made their first contribution in https://github.com/agniveshtm/flux/pull/5

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/agniveshtm/flux/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0

releases.name: Release v0.1.0
releases.body:
## What's Changed
* feat: deliver Flux file converter MVP with Vue 3 UI, Python backend, and pywebview shell by @agniveshtm in https://github.com/agniveshtm/flux/pull/1
* feat: release pipeline with auto-updater, CI workflows, and documentation by @agniveshtm in https://github.com/agniveshtm/flux/pull/2
* fix(app): resolve bundled frontend path in the packaged exe by @agniveshtm in https://github.com/agniveshtm/flux/pull/3

## New Contributors
* @agniveshtm made their first contribution in https://github.com/agniveshtm/flux/pull/1

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/agniveshtm/flux/commits/v0.1.0
